observations: body L1: a point is printed between «تصحيح» and «ذلك», at the level of the dots below the letters; not transcribed.
body L2, L3, L5: the kasra of r in «وأَجْرِ» (L2, L3) and «فأَجْرِهِ» (L5) is printed low, under the tail of the r.

body L3, L4, L18: «الرَسم» (L3) and «ومَا» (L4) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), the fatha of r (L3) and of m (L4) standing over the join; «المِجْلَدُ» (L18) is printed with an elongated join between l and d; not transcribed.
body L13: the point before the opening parenthesis («216 .(») is the full stop of the Arabic quotation, set at its end on the left; transcribed with the run.
body L16: the first reference is printed «٩٢» (its second digit 2.9 points wide, a 2), the second «٩٣» (4.8 points).
body L21: the sign over the lām-alif of «الٱجْتِمَاعَاتُ» is the waṣla, of the shape of the waṣla of «فٱعرفْ» on p. 321.
body L25: a point is printed between the first two X of «XXXVII»; not transcribed.

body L30, L32, L35: «ὅροι» (L30, L32) is printed with the δ-shaped sort of omicron with a second stroke at its head (rough breathing and acute), «ὁ» (L35) with the plain δ-shaped sort; transcribed «ὅ» and «ὁ».
body L34, L37: a point is printed below the line between «eclipses» and «Solis», and a short stroke over the 2 of «32» (L34); a stroke is printed below the i of «designatur» (L37); not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
